company.name: Center for a New American Security

profile_text.body:
The Center for a New American Security, which goes by CNAS, is a nonprofit founded in 2007 and headquartered in Washington, DC. Its website is cnas.org. The organization describes itself as developing strong, pragmatic and principled national security and defense policies.

Its published material covers artificial intelligence. The site states that AI systems continue to progress at a steady pace and that this trend has fed forecasts about artificial general intelligence. It says CNAS launched the Sovereign AI Index to track every government-backed sovereign AI project since 2023, projects it says seek to improve a country's AI self-reliance. The site also carries commentary referring to Kimi K3 identifying itself as Claude, Anthropic's model, and a quotation about a Hugging Face incident followed by the release of a model that is harder to monitor.

No AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for the organization. Its legal exposure is recorded in Washington with a count of 107.
